focus: Inland ecology with published coordinates: Asir and Al-Bahah juniper (Juniperus procera) woodlands and dieback study plots, montane endemic plant sites, Arabian leopard / baboon / bird survey localities, Raghadan or Shada forests, Najran wadi vegetation, Riyadh rawdat (e.g. Rawdat Nourah, Rawdat Al-Tinhat) and acacia woodland plots, Northern Borders and Hail rangeland or sand-dune vegetation study sites; Al-Bahah geology (Arabian Shield granite/gneiss outcrops) and archaeology (Thee Ain is already mapped — choose another).
